name: Mary Young

events.title: 1840 census
events.description: Female aged 60-69 in the household of Fred'k Croup (male 70-79), consistent with birth c.1771-80.

bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree gives Maria (Young) Croup a birth in January 1776 and a death on 3 September 1842, and makes her the eldest child of Johannes Jung of Easton (d. before 12 September 1787) and Anna Maria Doll (1751-1813). Its only attached source is 'last will of Maria Young, Northampton Co PA, Will Book 4, p.458' (S1) - evidently the 1813 will of her widowed mother, which would be the first document to tie Mary Croup to the Young-Doll family. The tree lists her siblings as Sara (1777), Johannes (1781-1813), Susannah (1783), Peter (1784-1854), Catherine, Elizabeth, Henry, Jacob and Margaretha Young (S1). In 1840 a woman in her sixties was living with Frederick Croup in Plymouth Township, matching her (S2).

conflicts.foundValue: Johannes Jung, b. c.1745, d. before 12 Sep 1787 (FamilySearch)
conflicts.assessment: FS dates suggest the tree has given John Young his widow's death year (1813). Unverified; the will of Maria Young (Northampton Will Book 4 p.458) would settle it.
